title: Novel mixed matrix membranes with indium-based 2D and 3D MOFs as fillers and polysulfone for CO2/CH4 mixed gas separation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2996-3007
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08557D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aditya Jonnalagedda, Bhanu Vardhan Reddy Kuncharam
Mixed gas separation study with novel mixed matrix membranes (MMM) fabricated with 3D (MIL-68(In)–NH2) and 2D (In(aip)2) indium-based MOFs. Prepared MMMs showed good CO2/CH4 separation and long-term stability at lower pressure.
